contains.label: Contains
contains.summary: {source} contains {target} as a declared theory, object, or subdomain.
contains.inverseSummary: {source} is a declared facet, object, or subdomain of {target}.
contains.claimBoundary: Containment declares conceptual scope; each record retains its own claim and evidence boundaries.

definedWithin.label: Defined within
definedWithin.summary: {source} is defined within the declared scope of {target}.
definedWithin.inverseSummary: {source} defines the declared scope within which {target} is interpreted.
definedWithin.claimBoundary: Definition supplies scope, not independent validation or operational authority.

studiedBy.label: Studied by
studiedBy.summary: {source} is studied through the research or analytic program recorded by {target}.
studiedBy.inverseSummary: {source} studies the object or domain recorded by {target}.
studiedBy.claimBoundary: Study does not transfer authority or imply that either record validates every claim made by the other.

formalizedThrough.label: Formalized through
formalizedThrough.summary: {source} is formalized through the apparatus maintained by {target}.
formalizedThrough.claimBoundary: Formal authority applies only to explicitly encoded definitions, assumptions, and results.

operationalizedBy.label: Operationalized by
operationalizedBy.summary: {source} is operationalized through the method recorded by {target}.
operationalizedBy.inverseSummary: {source} operationalizes parts of {target} within its declared method boundary.
operationalizedBy.claimBoundary: Operational use does not promote the source theory beyond its evidence or claim ceiling.

appliedThrough.label: Applied through
appliedThrough.summary: {source} is applied through the practice recorded by {target}.
appliedThrough.inverseSummary: {source} is a declared application route for {target}.
appliedThrough.claimBoundary: Application supplies use context, not automatic theoretical validation.

appliedBy.label: Applied by
appliedBy.summary: {source} is applied by {target} within a declared practice boundary.
appliedBy.inverseSummary: {source} applies parts of {target} within its declared practice boundary.
appliedBy.claimBoundary: The applied practice remains responsible for its own decisions, consequences, and evidence.

appliedWithin.label: Applied within
appliedWithin.summary: {source} is applied within the practice domain recorded by {target}.
appliedWithin.claimBoundary: Placement within a practice domain does not confer unrestricted professional authority.

dependsOn.label: Depends on
dependsOn.summary: {source} declares {target} as conceptual, formal, or operational grounding.
dependsOn.claimBoundary: Dependency identifies grounding; the grounding record does not thereby endorse dependent claims.

relatedTo.label: Related domain
relatedTo.summary: {source} and {target} share a declared contextual relation.
relatedTo.inverseSummary: {source} and {target} share a declared contextual relation.
relatedTo.claimBoundary: Adjacency supplies context only; it does not imply endorsement, equivalence, or promotion.

theoreticalGrounding.label: Theoretical grounding
theoreticalGrounding.summary: {source} names {target} as part of its theoretical grounding.
theoreticalGrounding.claimBoundary: Grounding must be traced to specific definitions and claims before it can carry formal weight.

practiceGrounding.label: Practice grounding
practiceGrounding.summary: {source} names {target} as part of its practice grounding.
practiceGrounding.claimBoundary: Practice proximity does not transfer professional authority or evidence.

facetOf.label: Facet of
facetOf.summary: {source} is a declared facet, object, or subdomain of {target}.
facetOf.inverseSummary: {source} contains {target} as a declared theory, object, or subdomain.
facetOf.claimBoundary: Facet status inherits scope from the parent while preserving a separate claim and evidence record.

centralObject.label: Central object
centralObject.summary: {source} studies or operates on the central object recorded by {target}.
centralObject.inverseSummary: {source} is recorded as a central object of {target}.
centralObject.claimBoundary: Object selection constrains scope; it does not establish a result by itself.

formalApparatusFor.label: Formal apparatus for
formalApparatusFor.claimBoundary: The apparatus governs only results stated under its declared assumptions and proof conditions.

encodes.label: Encodes
encodes.summary: {source} encodes parts of the theory or discipline recorded by {target}.
encodes.claimBoundary: Encoding preserves only declared structure and does not imply complete equivalence.

composedOf.label: Composed of
composedOf.claimBoundary: Composition declares structure without collapsing the distinct claim, evidence, or lifecycle boundaries of either record.

discipline.label: Discipline
discipline.summary: {source} is situated within the discipline recorded by {target}.
discipline.claimBoundary: Disciplinary placement supplies method and context, not automatic validation.

distinctFrom.label: Distinct from
distinctFrom.claimBoundary: Declared distinction prevents conflation; it does not imply opposition, exclusion, or comparative authority.

formalApparatus.label: Uses formal apparatus
formalApparatus.claimBoundary: Use of an apparatus is bounded by its declared assumptions, translations, and proof conditions.

governedBy.label: Governed by
governedBy.summary: {source} is governed by the authority and stewardship recorded by {target}.
governedBy.inverseSummary: {source} governs the declared stewardship boundary of {target}.
governedBy.claimBoundary: Governance applies only within the authority, standing, and correction duties explicitly declared by the governing record.

operatedThrough.label: Operated through
operatedThrough.summary: {source} is operated through the process or system recorded by {target}.
operatedThrough.inverseSummary: {source} operates on {target} within a declared process boundary.
operatedThrough.claimBoundary: Operational linkage does not transfer ownership, evidence, or unrestricted mutation authority.

operatesOn.label: Operates on
operatesOn.summary: {source} operates on {target} within a declared process boundary.
operatesOn.inverseSummary: {source} is operated through the process or system recorded by {target}.
operatesOn.claimBoundary: Operational linkage does not transfer ownership, evidence, or unrestricted mutation authority.

pairedResearchLane.label: Paired research lane
pairedResearchLane.summary: {source} and {target} are maintained as paired, distinct research lanes.
pairedResearchLane.inverseSummary: {source} and {target} are maintained as paired, distinct research lanes.
pairedResearchLane.claimBoundary: Pairing coordinates inquiry without merging methods, claims, or evidence.

siblingFacets.label: Sibling facet
siblingFacets.summary: {source} and {target} are sibling facets within a shared theoretical family.
siblingFacets.inverseSummary: {source} and {target} are sibling facets within a shared theoretical family.
siblingFacets.claimBoundary: Sibling status expresses shared placement while preserving distinct definitions and obligations.
